name: UpdateApiMcpServerCore

parameters.help_en: A client-generated token to ensure request idempotence. When you retry a request, use the same token to prevent the system from performing the operation twice
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求幂等性的唯一标识。在创建或更新资源时，如果多次使用相同的 ClientToken 发起请求，系统会将其视为同一次操作，从而避免重复创建或更新。ClientToken 由客户端生成，建议在重试场景中使用相同的 ClientToken
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the ApiMcpServerCore resource
parameters.help_zh: 创建成功的 API MCP Core 服务 ID
parameters.name: id

parameters.help_en:
The client ID for a custom OAuth configuration.

Only web and native applications are supported. The OAuth scope must include `/acs/mcp-server`
parameters.help_zh:
选择自定义OAuth配置时的自定义OAuth Client ID。

`仅支持 Web/Native 应用，且 OAuth 范围必须包含 /acs/mcp-server`
parameters.name: oauth_client_id

parameters.help_en: The source VPC IDs to add to the VPC whitelist
parameters.help_zh: 每一个限定的VPC白名单，值为来源VPC ID
parameters.name: vpc_whitelists

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable multi-account access
parameters.name: enable_assume_role

parameters.help_en: The name of the RAM role to assume in the target account when multi-account access is enabled
parameters.help_zh: 开启多账号访问进行跨账号操作时，扮演的目标账号 RAM角色名称
parameters.name: assume_role_name

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable public access, disable it, or inherit the account-level configuration. Valid values: `public`, `private`, and `inherit`
parameters.help_zh:
公网访问类型：允许公网访问、不允许公网访问、继承账号配置。
`public`（开启）, `private`（关闭）, `inherit`（跟随账号配置）
parameters.name: public_access_type

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable a custom VPC whitelist. If disabled, the account-level configuration is used
parameters.help_zh: 是否开启自定义VPC白名单，不开启则跟随账户级别的配置
parameters.name: enable_custom_vpc_whitelist
